IndiGo Flight Delayed by Bomb Threat Note

An IndiGo flight from Kolkata to Gorakhpur was delayed by four hours due to a bomb threat note found on a toilet paper roll. The note caused the aircraft to be thoroughly searched. The incident led to the flight's significant delay. Separately, IndiGo issued a travel advisory warning of potential flight delays in Delhi due to bad weather.
